o-weekend.answer: No. Orders are picked and shipped on business days only.

o-ground.answer: Standard ground delivery takes three to five business days.

o-expedited.answer: Expedited delivery takes two business days.

o-free-parcel.answer: Parcel shipping is free on orders over $500.

o-pickup.answer: Yes. Choose warehouse pickup for the Riverbend or Eastgate warehouse.

o-track.answer: Open the order in the Portal to see carrier tracking.

o-engraving.answer: Custom cutting or engraving adds three business days.

o-backorder.answer: Back-ordered items ship separately at no extra cost.

o-damage.answer: Report damage within five days of delivery with photos.

o-liftgate.answer: Add the liftgate option when you book the freight appointment.

o-reorder.answer: Open Order history and choose Reorder.

o-approval.answer: An approval rule holds it until an approver accepts it.

o-no-account.answer: No. Every order needs a Portal account.

o-stock.answer: Each product page shows stock at your nearest warehouse.

o-combine.answer: Only if both orders are still waiting to be picked.

o-international.answer: International shipping is only for enterprise contracts.

o-no-one-home.answer: The carrier reschedules, and a redelivery fee may apply.

o-freight-days.answer: Freight deliveries are scheduled within one business day.

p-card-days.answer: Card refunds usually appear within seven business days.

p-net30.answer: Standard accounts pay on net 30 terms.

p-old-invoice.answer: Every invoice since 2019 can be downloaded.

p-return-start.answer: Open the order and choose Start return.

p-exchange.answer: Choose Exchange in the returns center.

p-inspect.answer: Most returns are inspected within five business days.

p-invoice-day.answer: Invoices are emailed the day an order ships.

p-dispute.answer: Open the invoice and choose Dispute.

p-tax.answer: Upload the exemption certificate in Settings.

p-po-credit.answer: They receive a credit note for their next invoice.

p-labels.answer: Only unopened label rolls can be returned.

p-annual.answer: No. Annual plans are never partly refunded; the plan runs to the end of its term.

p-late-fee.answer: 1.5 percent per month on invoices unpaid 15 days after the due date.

p-return-ship.answer: The customer, unless the item was wrong or defective.

p-custom-cut.answer: No. Made-to-order items are final sale unless defective.

p-bank.answer: Bank transfer is for invoices over $2,000.

p-enterprise-terms.answer: Enterprise accounts usually pay on net 45 terms.

p-gift-card.answer: Gift cards and promotional credit are not refunded to cash.

x-wren-price.answer: A Wren WL-4 is $310 for one to nine units.

x-heron-load.answer: Each Heron bay is rated for 900 kilograms.

x-wren-wifi.answer: Hold the feed button for five seconds until the light blinks blue.

x-k3-k2-site.answer: Yes. Both use the same receiving screens and Wren printers.

x-trade-in.answer: A $60 credit toward a K3 for a working K2, until the end of 2025.

x-wren-red.answer: A blinking red light means the roll is empty.

x-k3-battery.answer: No. K3 and K2 batteries have different shapes.

x-ds-battery.answer: No. Batteries are warranted for one year.

x-heron-tall.answer: Yes. Bays over 2.5 m must also be tied to a wall or the bay behind.

x-wren-clean.answer: Every five rolls, or sooner if labels look faded.

x-ds-forklift.answer: No. Forklift impact is excluded from the warranty.

x-k2-sold.answer: Yes. The K2 stays in the catalog through at least 2026.
